title: Juicy British Cod Fish And Chips
description: A citrusy and dense British cod and chips dish infused with gochugaru, cooked in a cataplana for a halal-friendly twist.
instructions: Brine the cod fillets in 500 ml of water, 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp sugar for 20 minutes.
Drain the cod and pat dry with paper towels.
Whisk together flour, baking powder, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tsp pepper, and 1 tsp gochugaru until combined.
Dip each cod fillet in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a cataplana over medium heat until shimmering.
Place the coated fillets in the pan and sear for 3 minutes on each side until golden.
Remove the fillets and set aside.
Toss sliced potatoes with 1 tbsp salt and a drizzle of olive oil.
Add the potatoes to the same cataplana, covering the bottom, and cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Return the cod fillets to the pan, squeeze lemon juice over the top, and simmer for an additional 5 minutes before serving.
